description: React component for a mobile shopping cart summary in a food delivery web app, including cart calculation, tax, and navigation to checkout.

methods.name: didFocus
methods.description: Fetches and transforms cart items based on restaurant data, updates cart state, and shows messages if items are unavailable.

methods.name: calculatePrice
methods.description: Calculates total price of items in cart.

methods.name: taxCalculation
methods.description: Calculates tax amount based on restaurant tax rate.

methods.name: calculateTotal
methods.description: Calculates total amount including price and tax.
